name: Asthma
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the ultimate healer who promises to protect His people from diseases when they obey His commandments, as seen in Exodus 15:26. The Lord empowers His followers to overcome sickness and unclean spirits, demonstrating His authority over all ailments, including conditions like asthma (Matthew 10:1). Believers are encouraged to call upon God in prayer, trusting that He will answer and reveal His mighty works (Jeremiah 33:3), while remembering that life and breath come from Him alone (Acts 17:25). Above all, God's love is shown through the gift of His Son, offering eternal life beyond physical affliction (John 3:16).
